events.title: Demo Update – Visual Refresh & Improvements
events.summary: Hello everyone!Here is today's demo update:• Reworked the house interior with improved details and color adjustments• Raised the ceiling height to make jumping over PC cases easier• Completely redesigned the Titan GPU model• Completely redesigned the game's logo• Added brand-new Steam capsule artworkThank you so much for all the wishlists, demo downloads, and feedback. Every update helps make Hamstr Protocol better, and there's still much more coming before launch.Sebastian

events.title: Demo Update: Bug Fixes and Lighting
events.summary: Hello everyone!Here is today's demo update:• Fixed items not coming back from your second backpack slot after using the trash• Hamsters can no longer be thrown in the trash• Fixed the hamster stats card getting stuck on screen• Fixed buttons shrinking when clicked rapidly (auto-clickers)• Removed the blue tint that bled onto every object, interiors now look neutral• Toned down glow on bright surfaces, it now stays on lamps, LEDs and signs Thank you so much for all the wishlists and the feedback!

events.title: 🎉 Hamstr Protocol Reaches 1,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: We've officially reached 1,000 wishlists on Steam!Just two weeks ago we were at around 100 wishlists, so seeing so many people discover Hamstr Protocol has been absolutely incredible. A huge thank you to everyone who:- Played the demo- Added the game to their wishlist- Shared it with friends- Created videos and streams- Sent bug reports and feedbackEvery wishlist, comment, and message of support motivates me to keep improving the game. events.title: Demo update: Controller support
events.summary: Hello everyone!Here is today's demo update:• Added partial controller support, including Steam Deck support• Added more decorations around the map• Improved UI hover and click sound effects• Made the UI feel more responsive and polished• Fixed various UI issues and minor bugs Thank you so much for 900 wishlists and all the feedback!Sebastian

events.title: Demo Update

events.title: Hamstr Protocol: Official Demo Now Available!
events.summary: Hello everyone!I’m incredibly excited to announce that the official demo for Hamstr Protocol is finally live and ready to play for free on Steam!Dive into your very own bio-mining operation, set up your rigs, manage that hardware heat, and see if you can turn HAM into real profit. Since this is the first public build, I would absolutely love to hear your thoughts, feedback, or any bugs you might find.
